params.prompt: [Static shot] Viewed directly from behind, the character walks in place with short, soft, low steps. His boots lift only slightly off the ground as his legs alternate smoothly. His upper arms rest close against his torso and his hands make tiny movements beside his hips. His head and shoulders stay level, his back square to the camera, and his body centered at the same size. His deep charcoal suit, dark brown hair, burgundy patches, equipment, lighting and plain green background remain unchanged.
